parts.text:
He encontrado varios conceptos OMOP para "Lyme disease" en el dominio de 'Condition'. Por favor, indique cuál de estos conceptos representa mejor la variable de estudio que busca para la enfermedad de Lyme:

| Concept ID | Concept Name                   | Domain    | Vocabulary |
|:-----------|:-------------------------------|:----------|:-----------|
| 440638     | Lyme disease                   | Condition | SNOMED     |
| 4142570    | Acute lyme disease             | Condition | SNOMED     |
| 4080443    | Skeletal Lyme disease          | Condition | SNOMED     |
| 4080619    | Congenital Lyme disease        | Condition | SNOMED     |
| 4339485    | Lyme disease of inner ear      | Condition | SNOMED     |

¿Cuál de estos conceptos representa mejor su variable de estudio?

Confirmo los conceptos 440638, 4044930, 4080443, 4080619. Por favor genera la consulta SQL para BigQuery consultando las tablas del vocabulario y modelo OMOP (condition_era, person, location, concept_relationship, concept) para obtener los conceptos o registros relacionados.

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    l.state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.person_id) AS distinct_patients_with_lyme_disease,
    MIN(ce.condition_era_start_date) AS first_lyme_case_date,
    MAX(ce.condition_era_end_date) AS last_lyme_case_date
FROM
    `condition_era` AS ce
JOIN
    `person` AS p
ON
    ce.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN
    `location` AS l
ON
    p.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE
    ce.condition_concept_id IN (440638, 4044930, 4080443, 4080619)
GROUP BY
    l.state
ORDER BY
    distinct_patients_with_lyme_disease DESC;

args.sql_query:
WITH LymeDiseaseConceptIDs AS (
    -- User-approved standard concepts for Lyme disease
    SELECT concept_id FROM UNNEST([440638, 4044930, 4080443, 4080619]) AS concept_id
    UNION DISTINCT
    -- Standard concepts that map from ICD9CM '088.81'
    SELECT
        c_to.concept_id
    FROM
        `concept` AS c_from
    JOIN
        `concept_relationship` AS cr
        ON c_from.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    JOIN
        `concept` AS c_to
        ON cr.concept_id_2 = c_to.concept_id
    WHERE
        c_from.concept_code = '088.81'
        AND c_from.vocabulary_id = 'ICD9CM'
        AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
        AND c_to.standard_concept = 'S'
        AND c_to.domain_id = 'Condition'
),
LymeDiseasePatients AS (
    SELECT
        l.state,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) AS year_of_diagnosis,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients_with_lyme_disease
    FROM
        `condition_occurrence` AS co
    JOIN
        `person` AS p
        ON co.person_id = p.person_id
    JOIN
        `location` AS l
        ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE
        co.condition_start_date IS NOT NULL AND l.state IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM LymeDiseaseConceptIDs)
            OR co.condition_source_value = '088.81'
        )
    GROUP BY
        l.state,
        year_of_diagnosis
),
TotalPopulation AS (
    SELECT
        l.state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS total_population_in_state
    FROM
        `person` AS p
    JOIN
        `location` AS l
        ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE
        l.state IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        l.state
)
SELECT
    ldp.state,
    ldp.year_of_diagnosis,
    ldp.patients_with_lyme_disease,
    tp.total_population_in_state,
    CAST(ldp.patients_with_lyme_disease AS BIGNUMERIC) / tp.total_population_in_state * 100000 AS incidence_rate_per_100000_person_years
FROM
    LymeDiseasePatients AS ldp
JOIN
    TotalPopulation AS tp
    ON ldp.state = tp.state
WHERE
    tp.total_population_in_state > 0
ORDER BY
    ldp.state,
    ldp.year_of_diagnosis;

Por favor, revisa y optimiza la consulta SQL para BigQuery OMOP CDM 5.4 resolviendo las siguientes observaciones técnicas y clínicas del evaluador:

La consulta del agente demuestra un buen uso de las CTEs y un intento correcto de mapear códigos fuente. La inclusión del 'year_of_diagnosis' es adecuada para calcular la incidencia temporal. Sin embargo, el principal defecto clínico y epidemiológico radica en el cálculo de la tasa de incidencia. La CTE 'TotalPopulation' calcula el número total de personas distintas por estado, sin considerar el año. Al usar este valor como denominador para una 'incidence_rate_per_100000_person_years' donde el numerador es específico por año, la métrica resultante no es una verdadera tasa de incidencia anual por años-persona. Se trata más bien de una proporción de casos anuales respecto a la población total enrolada en el estado, lo cual es una interpretación errónea. Además, la codificación de IDs de concepto específicos para la enfermedad de Lyme hace la solución menos flexible que el enfoque del Gold Standard que utiliza 'condition_era' y un mapeo más robusto de códigos ICD.

Emite directamente la sentencia SQL ejecutable final, sin explicaciones adicionales ni pasos intermedios.

WITH LymeDiseaseStandardConcepts AS (
    -- Conceptos estándar aprobados por el usuario para la enfermedad de Lyme
    SELECT concept_id FROM UNNEST([440638, 4044930, 4080443, 4080619]) AS concept_id
    UNION DISTINCT
    -- Conceptos estándar que se mapean desde el código ICD9CM '088.81'
    SELECT
        c_to.concept_id
    FROM
        `concept` AS c_from
    JOIN
        `concept_relationship` AS cr
        ON c_from.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    JOIN
        `concept` AS c_to
        ON cr.concept_id_2 = c_to.concept_id
    WHERE
        c_from.concept_code = '088.81'
        AND c_from.vocabulary_id = 'ICD9CM'
        AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
        AND c_to.standard_concept = 'S'
        AND c_to.domain_id = 'Condition'
),
LymeDiseaseCasesByYearState AS (
    SELECT
        l.state,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) AS year_of_diagnosis,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ce.person_id) AS incident_cases_of_lyme_disease
    FROM
        `condition_era` AS ce
    JOIN
        `person` AS p
        ON ce.person_id = p.person_id
    JOIN
        `location` AS l
        ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE
        ce.condition_era_start_date IS NOT NULL AND l.state IS NOT NULL
        AND ce.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM LymeDiseaseStandardConcepts)
    GROUP BY
        l.state,
        year_of_diagnosis
),
YearsInObservation AS (
    SELECT
        p.person_id,
        l.state,
        y.year_val AS year_of_observation
    FROM
        `observation_period` AS op
    JOIN
        `person` AS p
        ON op.person_id = p.person_id
    JOIN
        `location` AS l
        ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    JOIN
        (SELECT year_val FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1900, 2100)) AS year_val) AS y -- Rango de años, ajustar según los datos
        ON y.year_val BETWEEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM op.observation_period_start_date) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM op.observation_period_end_date)
    WHERE
        l.state IS NOT NULL
),
PopulationAtRiskByYearState AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        year_of_observation,
        COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total_person_count_in_year
    FROM
        YearsInObservation
    GROUP BY
        state,
        year_of_observation
)
SELECT
    ldc.state,
    ldc.year_of_diagnosis,
    ldc.incident_cases_of_lyme_disease,
    pars.total_person_count_in_year,
    CAST(ldc.incident_cases_of_lyme_disease AS BIGNUMERIC) / pars.total_person_count_in_year * 100000 AS annual_incidence_rate_per_100000
FROM
    LymeDiseaseCasesByYearState AS ldc
JOIN
    PopulationAtRiskByYearState AS pars
    ON ldc.state = pars.state AND ldc.year_of_diagnosis = pars.year_of_observation
WHERE
    pars.total_person_count_in_year > 0
ORDER BY
    ldc.state,
    ldc.year_of_diagnosis;

LymeDiseaseCasesByYearState AS (
    -- Casos incidentes de enfermedad de Lyme por estado y año, utilizando condition_era para una definición más robusta del caso
    SELECT
        l.state,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) AS year_of_diagnosis,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ce.person_id) AS incident_cases_of_lyme_disease

        AND ce.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM LymeDiseaseStandardConcepts)
    GROUP BY
        l.state,
        year_of_diagnosis
),
YearsInObservation AS (
    -- Genera una fila por cada persona por cada año que estuvo en observación, por estado
    SELECT
        p.person_id,
        l.state,
        year_val AS year_of_observation
    FROM
        `observation_period` AS op
    JOIN
        `person` AS p
        ON op.person_id = p.person_id
    JOIN
        `location` AS l
        ON p.location_id = l.location_id,
        UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM op.observation_period_start_date),
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM op.observation_period_end_date)

    WHERE

        state,
        year_of_observation,
        COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total_person_count_in_year
    FROM
        YearsInObservation
    GROUP BY
        state,
        year_of_observation
)
